integrity: Infinite correctness uses a local saturation/counting proof and a leaf-extension induction. The finite standalone verifier is supplementary. The known two-leaf value is explicitly credited to prior work.
limitations: Exact star result assumes at least two leaves and a six-cycle. The universal graph statement is a lower bound, not an exact formula for arbitrary base graphs. No optimal-coloring count or other cycle length is claimed. Literature priority is not independently certified.
title: Six-cycle saturation obstruction for strong edge coloring of star products
